name: Dynasty: Total Supremacy
storyline:
In the late Eastern Han Dynasty, corruption plagued the imperial court, the Yellow Turban Rebellion erupted, and the realm plunged into a period of great turmoil marked by war and chaos. Heroes emerged in droves, and regional warlords emerged to wage war against one another. In Dynasty: Total Supremacy, you’ll take on the role of a regional warlord—whether it’s Cao Cao, who used the Emperor as a figurehead to command the feudal lords; Liu Bei, who sought to restore the Han dynasty; Sun Quan, who ruled over Jiangdong; or a regional lord who declared himself king. Starting with just a single city, you’ll gradually build your empire through domestic governance, diplomatic maneuvering, strategic unit synergies, and epic real-time battles featuring tens of thousands of units on a single screen—forging your own legacy of dominance in the Three Kingdoms era!

The course of history will be entirely in your hands: you can recreate the ambush at the Battle of Guandu, or harness the east wind on the night of the Battle of Red Cliffs to rewrite the power balance in the Three Kingdoms. Only true heroes can shape the destiny of the realm!
summary: Dynasty: Total Supremacy is a large-scale real-time strategy and grand strategy game set against the real Three Kingdoms period.
